data_description.api_key: API key for the selected provider.
data_description.prompt:
Prompt can be used to improve speech recognition of words or even names.
You have to provide a list of words or names separated by a comma ", ".
Example: `open, close, Chat GPT-3, DALL·E`

data_description.url: Your server URL. A URL without a path gets the standard endpoint appended (`https://host` and `https://host/v1` both become `https://host/v1/audio/transcriptions`); any URL that already includes a path is used as-is, e.g. `http://host:8000/asr` (whisper-asr-webservice).
data_description.api_key: Leave empty if your server does not require an API key.
data_description.model: Model name accepted by your server (e.g. `whisper-1`, `Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3`).

data_description.file_field: Multipart field used to upload the audio. Most OpenAI-compatible servers use `file`; whisper-asr-webservice needs `audio_file`. If unsure, keep `file`: the integration detects and retries automatically on a 422 response.
